cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?

mechanism: A turns its former practical pupil request for a ladder into a lesson in exchanging specific benefits, pricing even a claim of friendship.
confusable: Not one opportunistic bargain: every softer reframe from B acquires a concrete exchange value from A.
comparison: Tool loan paid in food versus apology paid in reciprocal admission.
